repositoryVariables.ROSEOS_BUILDER_RUNNER_READY: 'true' only after the repository-scoped runner labelled roseos-frankel-builder is registered on immortal-os-builder
repositoryVariables.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER: Full resource name of the GitHub OIDC provider restricted to this repository, main and os-release.yml
repositoryVariables.GCP_CONTROLLER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Identity limited to get/start/stop of immortal-os-builder
repositoryVariables.GCP_SIGNER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Identity limited to reading the six existing signing secrets
repositoryVariables.PIXEL_OTA_APP_ID: App ID of the publisher App installed only on Immortal-Protocols/pixel-ota (Contents: write, Metadata: read)

repositorySecrets.PIXEL_OTA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: Publisher App private key; read only by the hosted publisher token step

hostInputs.host.tools.apksigner: Stable apksigner on the runner, configured only after its installation is verified
hostInputs.host.integrate.appSdkRoot: Android SDK root whose build-tools/android-15 holds zipalign and apksigner for scripts/sign-apk.py
hostInputs.host.integrate.appBuildCommand: argv recipe building the unsigned apps from {candidate} with the real public connection assets; placeholders {candidate} {release_dir} {build}
hostInputs.host.integrate.unsignedApks: {"voice": path, "agent": path, "target:<package>": path} written by appBuildCommand
hostInputs.host.integrate.reconcileCommand: argv recipe applying the candidate into the retained tree; placeholders {candidate} {release_dir} {policy} {signed_apps}
hostInputs.host.sign.keyDirectory: Directory inside the key archive holding releasekey.x509.pem and avb_pkmd.bin
hostInputs.host.sign.releaseCommand: argv recipe for the source tree release script; placeholders {device} {build} {keys} {passphrase_file} {release_dir}
hostInputs.host.sign.outputs: {"signedTargetFiles": path, "public": {asset name: path}} produced by releaseCommand (all seven assets except verification.json)
